subject: Re: Pen test closure — artifacts, configs, and compensating controls
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <security@finova.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Oliver Park <oliver.park@finova.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pen test closure — we need artifacts and confirmations

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. The pen test report you shared looks good overall, but our auditors need artifacts to close the finding on session fixation and the rate-limiting gap the testers flagged. Specifically we need:

- Screenshots of the runtime dashboard showing the WAF rule that blocks the test payloads and the matching rule ID.
- Config snippet showing the rate-limiting rule(s) you applied (or the nginx config where it's enforced).
- The ticket(s) that tracked the remediation work and the deployment window.
- Any compensating controls (monitoring alerts, retrospective log retention changes) that were enabled while we validated the patch.

If you can send PDFs/screenshots and point us to the Jira tickets (or provide an export), we can mark the finding as remediated. We prefer artifacts that link the fix to the production deployment (timestamps, ticket IDs).

Appreciate a reply by EOD Monday — our audit window closes the 30th.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Senior Security Engineer, Finova

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <security@finova.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pen test closure — artifacts and confirmations

Hi Lena — thanks for the clear list. Short summary of what we'll provide: screenshots from the production WAF console, the nginx rate-limit config we applied at the ingress layer, and the Jira remediation ticket with implementation logs. For compensating controls we enabled an SR-Alert rule (IDS + pager) for 72 hours and retained detailed request logs for an additional 30 days.

Plan/timeline: we will:
- Attach initial screenshots and the ticket export by 2026-06-28 EOD (Pacific).
- Upload the config snippets and a short remediation statement (signed by eng) by 2026-06-29 mid-day.

I'll include artifact names in the Jira ticket so you can cross-reference. If you need signed attestation from product/security, Marissa will be able to provide that.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <security@finova.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pen test closure — artifacts and confirmations

Hi Lena — attaching the artifacts you requested. Summary below and attachments are in the Drive link in the footer.

What we attached:
- pt-summary-statement.pdf — short remediation summary and acceptance criteria (signed by Product Security).
- console-waf-rule-screenshot-20260628.png — Production WAF console showing the rule (rule ID: rwf-8132) and the block hits from the test payload (timestamp: 2026-06-28T22:15:41Z).
- nginx-rate-limit.conf.txt — ingress snippet, applied via ConfigMap and rolled out in the 2026-06-28_22:00 UTC deployment.
- jira-INF-3245-implementation-log.txt — export of the implementation comments and the deployment audit (INF-3245).

Compensating controls enabled concurrently:
- Short-term: SR-Alert rule to pager team (72 hours) and increase of request-level logging for the affected service for +30 days (s3://redwood-logs/finova/2026/06/).
- Monitoring: Grafana dashboard snapshot attached showing the spike in blocked requests and the post-fix flatline.

For internal traceability we used feature-flag ff-remediate-session-fix and validated with canary before wide rollout. If you want a signed attestation on company letterhead, I can route to Legal and Product Security for signature — let me know.

Attachments (also in Drive): console-waf-rule-screenshot-20260628.png, nginx-rate-limit.conf.txt, jira-INF-3245-implementation-log.txt, pt-summary-statement.pdf

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Director, Product Security
Redwood Inference

[Drive artifacts link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3Cpt_artifacts_finova]
From: Lena Ortiz <security@finova.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Oliver Park <oliver.park@finova.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 12:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pen test closure — artifacts and confirmations

Thanks Marissa — that is perfect. A couple of quick clarifications so our auditors can stamp the finding closed:

1) In the nginx snippet, can you highlight (or paste) the exact limit and burst values used? The export shows the block rule but not the numeric rate limit values.
2) For the SR-Alert, what's the on-call rotation that received the page (team name and runbook link)? We need the runbook reference in the audit note.

If you can reply with those two items today, we'll close the finding and update our SOC tracker.

Best,
Lena

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <security@finova.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pen test closure — artifacts and confirmations

Hi Lena — quick follow-up with the numeric values you asked for:

- nginx ingress rate limit (applied in ConfigMap ingress-ratelimit): limit_req_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=rlzone:10m rate=10r/s;
- limit_req in the location block: limit_req zone=rlzone burst=20 nodelay;

These values were chosen to throttle the test traffic while preserving legitimate spikes.

SR-Alert details:
- Pager team: infra-oncall (rotation: infra-oncall-weekly). Runbook: https://redwood-internal.company/runbooks/infra-oncall-incident-response
- Pager policy: pages for suspicious request patterns and WAF high-severity blocks during the 72-hour window. Pager history exported in jira-INF-3245-implementation-log.txt.

If you'd like I can also generate a signed remediation attestation and route it to your security mailbox.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Engineering Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference
